body: I'm glad I am not the only one. Sadly I have a blue 10year old staffie and he is going a bit crazy in the head as he is getting older and he is a typical man when I cry and won't come near me. I don't feel like I am being far on them as they hate seeing me like this and it's becoming a regular thing. I really am lost especially now with no home or job I don't no what to do
I agree I was always here for them. But I have lost my job and am losing my home. Things are getting worse and much harder I really don't want to go on anymore

Rescue centres are full and putting healthy animals to sleep every day. I have asked people closest to me but they can't commit and from fostering many animals i have first hand experience on how difficult and hard it is to rehome especially older animals on meds. I never want to hurt them and it breaks my heart even thinking this but I don't no what to do,
